welcome: Barka da zuwa! Nemo, duba kuma ka fahimci sabuwar postcode ɗinka ta hanyar magana. Ba mu tambayar sunanka, lambar wayarka ko NIN. Muna amfani da wurinka sau ɗaya kawai don nemo postcode ɗinka, ba ma ajiye shi. Ana goge saƙon murya bayan mun karanta shi.
declined: Babu matsala. Ba mu ajiye komai ba. Kana iya dawowa kowane lokaci.
ask_knew_before: Kafin mu fara: ka san sabuwar postcode ɗinka kafin yau?
menu: Me kake so ka yi? Danna makirufo ka yi magana, aika wurinka don samun postcode ɗinka, ko ka rubuta postcode don a duba ta.
ask_location: Don nemo postcode ɗinka, tsaya a ginin gidanka ka danna "Samo postcode ɗina" don aika wurinka.
confidence_low: Wannan shi ne gini mafi kusa da muka samu, mita {distance} daga gare ka. Idan za ka iya, kwatanta shi da postcode da ke jikin ginin gidanka.
postcode_not_found: Ba mu sami postcode na gini kusa da kai ba. Fita waje, kusa da ginin gidanka, ka sake aika wurinka.
location_denied: Ba mu iya samun wurinka ba. Ba wa wannan shafin izinin amfani da wuri a saitunan burauzarka, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
validation_not_found: Ba a sami {display} ba. Duba kowane harafi da lamba, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
validation_bad_format: Wannan bai yi kama da postcode ba. Postcode tana kama da haka: LA 11 A12 GN 01.
ask_code: Faɗi ko rubuta postcode da kake so a duba, ko ka danna "Samo postcode ɗina" don aika wurinka ka sami postcode ɗinka.
explain_fallback: Postcode tana da sassa biyar. A cikin LA 11 A12 GN 01: LA ita ce jiha, 11 ita ce karamar hukuma, A12 ita ce gunduma, GN ita ce unguwa, 01 kuma shi ne gini.
not_heard: Ba mu ji hakan sosai ba. Don Allah ka sake gwadawa a wuri mai shiru, kusa da wayar.
audio_too_long: Wannan rikodin ya yi tsawo sosai. Don Allah ka yi magana ƙasa da daƙiƙa 20.
igbo_beta: Muryar Igbo tana cikin gwaji. Idan ba mu ji ka daidai ba, danna "Rubuta maimakon haka".
waking_up: Ana farawa. Amsar farko na iya ɗaukar har minti 3. Don Allah ka bar wannan shafin a buɗe.
timeout_retry: Wannan yana ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo. Don Allah ka sake gwadawa bayan minti ɗaya.
error_slow: Sabis ɗin postcode yana tafiya a hankali yanzu. Don Allah ka sake gwadawa bayan minti ɗaya.
error_unavailable: Sabis ɗin postcode ba ya samuwa yanzu. Don Allah ka sake gwadawa daga baya.
error_generic: Yi haƙuri, wani abu ya lalace a ɓangarenmu. Don Allah ka sake gwadawa daga baya.
faq_what_is: Postcode lamba ce mai sassa biyar: jiha, karamar hukuma (LGA), gunduma, unguwa da rukunin gini. Ana rubuta ta kamar haka: AA-99-H77-BB-55, misali LA-11-A12-GN-01. Sabbin postcode na Najeriya sun fara aiki tun 1 ga Oktoba 2026.
faq_parts: Postcode tana da sassa biyar. A cikin LA-11-A12-GN-01: LA ita ce jiha, 11 karamar hukuma (LGA), A12 gunduma, GN unguwa, 01 kuma rukunin gini.
faq_since_when: Sabbin postcode na Najeriya sun fara aiki tun daga 1 ga Oktoba 2026.
faq_get_mine: Don samun postcode ɗinka, danna "Samo postcode ɗina" don aika wurinka. Za mu nemo postcode na inda kake.
faq_check_one: Don duba postcode, faɗe ta ko ka rubuta ta, misali LA 11 A12 GN 01. Za mu gaya maka ko ingantacciya ce.
faq_place_name_no: Ba za mu iya samun postcode ɗinka daga sunan titi ko sunan wuri ba. Danna "Samo postcode ɗina" don aika wurinka.
faq_privacy: Ba mu tambayar sunanka, lambar wayarka ko NIN. Muna amfani da wurinka sau ɗaya kawai don nemo postcode ɗinka, ba ma ajiye shi. Ana goge saƙon murya bayan mun karanta shi.
faq_who_built: Wani mai haɓaka manhaja mai zaman kansa ne ya gina wannan mataimaki don National AI Innovation Challenge 2026. N-ATLaS is an initiative of the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, and powered by Awarri Technologies. Bayanan postcode daga Nigeria Postcode API.
